subject.title: [Feature]: Make managed browser launch degrade cleanly when no display server is available

question: Should explicit headed no-display managed-browser launches expose a stable typed error envelope, and should the fallback policy remain limited to implicit/default headless resolution?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent route/client error shape and whether to broaden fallback semantics are public API and compatibility choices rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add Typed Error Envelope
options.body: Keep explicit headed mode fail-closed and add an additive `reason: "no_display_for_headed_profile"` plus typed details through route and client errors.

options.title: Broaden Fallback Policy
options.body: Allow more explicit headed profiles to fall back to headless, accepting the compatibility risk of overriding visible-browser intent.

options.title: Document Current Behavior Only
options.body: Declare the current text-only actionable error sufficient and close the request without adding machine-readable branching fields.

recommendation.title: Add Typed Error Envelope
recommendation.body: Keep explicit headed mode fail-closed and add an additive `reason: "no_display_for_headed_profile"` plus typed details through route and client errors.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current fallback/override behavior and is assigned to this issue, making him the best available owner for the API/policy choice.
